comment: Single source of truth for the long-form cut. Read by BOTH the Remotion composition (src/long/timeline.ts) and the audio synthesizer (scripts/make_longform_audio.py), so picture and soundtrack agree by construction. Frame lengths follow the brief's Section 12 long-form allocation: 60s intro, 90s per monitor, 120s subwoofer, 60s outro, at 30fps, with 30-frame crossfades between segments.
comment2: Per-segment internal cues, in frames relative to that segment's own start. The audio script places soft ticks on these; the scenes place the matching visual moments on the same numbers.
comment3: Music phases per PDF Section 10, keyed by segment id. minimal: subdued ambient + intricate micro-arpeggio. driving: mid-tempo pulse, wider stereo. sub: floor-shaking low-end swell. settle: strip back for the CTA.
